item.title: Aaron Jones: Avoids significant knee injury
item.description:
The left knee injury that forced Jones out of Sunday's 16-10 win over the Colts isn't considered significant, and the running back is viewed as day-to-day, Adam Schefter of ESPN reports.
Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

item.title: Cam Skattebo: Expected to be OK after hamstring tweak
item.description:
Skattebo is expected to "OK" after tweaking his hamstring on a 42-yard run in overtime during Sunday's 27-21 win over the Texans, Mike Garafolo of NFL Network reports.
Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

item.title: Saquon Barkley: 'Trending toward playing' Monday
item.description:
Barkley (hamstring), who is listed as questionable for Monday's game against the Cowboys, is "trending toward playing," Mike Garafolo of NFL Network reports.
Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

item.title: Xavier Worthy: Held to 11 yards on six targets
item.description:
Worthy caught three of six targets for 11 yards in Sunday's 20-3 loss to the Seahawks.

item.title: Travis Kelce: Moves to fifth on all-time catch list
item.description:
Kelce caught four of eight targets for 44 yards in Sunday's 20-3 loss to the Seahawks.
